selected_sources.text: In order to exactly reproduce a given result, it may be necessary to use programs in the exact versions used originally.
Even having noted which version was used of a given program, it is not always trivial to get hold of a program in anything but the current version.
In some cases, all that is needed is to store a single executable or source code file.
To ensure future availability, the only viable solution may then be to store a full virtual machine image of the operating system and program.
As a minimum, you should note the exact names and versions of the main programs you use.
When working with summarized results, you should as a minimum at least once generate, inspect, and validate the detailed values underlying the summaries.
